final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(product_quantity) AS c2, AVG(((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) * 1.0) / derived_total_cost) AS c3 FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(c2) AS m FROM s1) SELECT s1.invoice_number, s1.c2, s1.c3, s1.c2 - s2.m AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.c2 > s2.m ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
